description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
When Kitchen Finks enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Kitchen Finks trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
